CREATE VIEW high_fidelity_meshes AS
SELECT 
    m.facetregistry AS mesh_id,
    m.zoneref AS site_reference,
    e.equipform AS equipment,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::bigint AS face_count,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::bigint AS vertex_count,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS resolution,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS accuracy,
    ROUND(CAST(
        ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / 
         ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric ^ 2)) * 1000.0 
        AS numeric), 2) AS complexity_value
FROM mesh m
JOIN equipment e ON m.equipref = e.equipregistry
WHERE (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / 
      ((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric ^ 2) * 1000.0 > 5.0
  AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric < 1.0
  AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric < 0.5;
